notes.title: PlayTest V2
notes.content:
After getting feedback from players for the first PlayTest we added the following:
Short Game intro to orient the player
Added visual for 6th sense (previously only sound occurred when you touched lost objects)
Added more visual clues to help players find their way around
Added a key crosshair icon instead of a hand crosshair icon making unlocking more obvious to players
Made perspective based puzzles more easy to line up
Added load icon when loading saved games
